title: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client
As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
